metas.name: Wild Kratts
metas.description: Perfect for fans of The Magic School Bus, this show teaches kids about biology, zoology, and ecology through fun, high-energy adventures.

metas.name: Octonauts
metas.description: Like Special Agent Oso and Curious George, this show features friendly characters solving missions while teaching kids about marine biology.

metas.name: Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood
metas.description: Fans of Bluey will love this gentle, emotionally supportive animated series that focuses on social-emotional learning and coping skills.

metas.name: Cyberchase
metas.description: Similar to Peg + Cat and Numberblocks, this thrilling adventure series uses math and logic to solve mysteries and defeat challenges.

metas.name: Sid the Science Kid
metas.description: This show uses music and humor to encourage preschool science inquiry, perfect for fans of Ada Twist, Scientist.

metas.name: Super Why!
metas.description: Like WordGirl, this show promotes early literacy, spelling, and reading skills through interactive fairy-tale adventures.

metas.name: Martha Speaks
metas.description: Kids who enjoy WordGirl and Curious George will love learning new vocabulary words with Martha, a dog who gains the ability to speak.

metas.name: Dinosaur Train
metas.description: Combining trains and dinosaurs, this show captures kids' natural curiosity about science and paleontology in a fun, educational format.

metas.name: Phineas and Ferb
metas.description: A highly creative animated comedy that appeals to the STEM curiosity of Ada Twist, Scientist fans, featuring endless fun and invention.

metas.name: Team Umizoomi
metas.description: Combines math concept learning with heroic missions, serving as a great companion show to Peg + Cat and Numberblocks.

metas.name: Blaze and the Monster Machines
metas.description: An action-packed preschool show that introduces young viewers to science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM) concepts.

metas.name: Bubble Guppies
metas.description: Like Little Einsteins, this vibrant musical series teaches preschool math, science, and literacy concepts through engaging songs.

metas.name: PJ Masks
metas.description: Offers kids who love Batman: The Animated Series a much more preschool-friendly, colorful, and age-appropriate superhero team-up experience.

metas.name: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
metas.description: An excellent, gentle introduction to superhero action for young fans of Batman, emphasizing teamwork, friendship, and problem-solving.

metas.name: Sheriff Callie's Wild West
metas.description: A wholesome animated series teaching social skills and good morals, appealing to fans of Special Agent Oso and Clifford.

metas.name: Arthur
metas.description: A beloved classic focusing on childhood experiences, family relationships, and emotional growth, highly recommended for fans of Bluey.

metas.name: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse
metas.description: An interactive, problem-solving show that shares the friendly, task-oriented structure of Special Agent Oso and Little Einsteins.

metas.name: Trash Truck
metas.description: A beautiful, wholesome, and gentle show about friendship and discovery that captures the warm, comforting tone of Bluey.

metas.name: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
metas.description: Sparking curiosity about nature and science, this show is a wonderful match for fans of Curious George and Ada Twist, Scientist.

metas.name: Puffin Rock
metas.description: A gorgeous, calming, and educational nature show that parents and young kids will enjoy together, similar in warmth to Bluey.

metas.name: Go, Diego, Go!
metas.description: Focuses on animal rescue and science, providing interactive learning that fits right alongside Curious George and Special Agent Oso.

metas.name: Dora the Explorer
metas.description: An interactive show encouraging kids to solve puzzles, use basic math, and learn Spanish vocabulary on fun journeys.

metas.name: Wallykazam!
metas.description: A fantastic literacy-focused show that uses magic and humor to teach spelling, phonics, and reading, much like WordGirl.

metas.name: Ask the StoryBots
metas.description: Highly educational, funny, and visually diverse, this series answers complex kids' questions in a way fans of Ada Twist and Magic School Bus will love.

metas.name: Nature Cat
metas.description: Encourages outdoor exploration and nature appreciation, matching the adventurous spirit of Curious George and The Magic School Bus.

metas.name: Fancy Nancy
metas.description: Teaches elaborate vocabulary words in a playful, relatable way, making it a great alternative to WordGirl.

metas.name: Miles from Tomorrowland
metas.description: An outer space adventure that introduces real space science concepts, perfect for fans of the science-fiction aspects of The Magic School Bus.

metas.name: Spirit Riding Free
metas.description: An uplifting, adventure-filled series focusing on friendship, horses, and teamwork that provides wholesome entertainment for families.

metas.name: Chuggington
metas.description: Teaches kids about responsibility, active listening, and teamwork through the adventures of friendly trainee trains.

metas.name: Rusty Rivets
metas.description: Promotes engineering, recycling, and problem-solving concepts, directly appealing to fans of Ada Twist, Scientist.

metas.name: Justin Time
metas.description: Uses imaginative time travel to teach history, culture, and positive social-emotional lessons to young viewers.

metas.name: Tumble Leaf
metas.description: A visually stunning stop-motion series that teaches basic scientific principles through play, curiosity, and exploration.

metas.name: Beat Bugs
metas.description: A whimsical, musical show about friendly bugs that uses classic songs to teach gentle life lessons and values.

metas.name: Elena of Avalor
metas.description: Features rich storytelling, diverse folklore, and strong moral leadership, making it a wonderful family-friendly adventure series.

metas.name: Ready Jet Go!
metas.description: Created with cooperation from NASA, this fun show teaches astronomy and earth science to curious young minds.

metas.name: Pete the Cat
metas.description: A musical and highly relatable series about trying new things and staying cool, carrying a similar creative energy to Peg + Cat.

metas.name: Molly of Denali
metas.description: An educational show teaching literacy and research skills through informational text, highly aligned with the learning goals of WordGirl.

metas.name: My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic
metas.description: Focuses on complex emotional skills, strong friendships, and solving conflicts with kindness, highly praised by families.

metas.name: Jake and the Never Land Pirates
metas.description: Encourages teamwork and basic problem-solving skills through lighthearted, non-scary pirate adventures.

metas.name: The Lion Guard
metas.description: Focuses on environmental conservation, teamwork, and leadership, offering friendly adventure for young fans of nature and animals.
